versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Work Productivity Weather Current Workflow Helper skill.
- Designed to assist users with high-demand Weather-style workflows, including bug fixes, setup hardening, reliability improvements, and adjacent use cases.
- Provides step-by-step workflow production, artifact generation, and practical implementation support.
- Emphasizes reusable checklists and outputs, focused on local-hardware-friendly approaches.
- Includes built-in output validation and transparent listing of requirements, assumptions, and follow-up steps.
